newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread drops after new CEO announcement.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread drops after new CEO announcement.

text.p: Shares in Whitbread Plc eased on Thursday after the British leisure to brewery group announced it named David Thomas as chief executive designate.
By 1144 GMT, the shares were down 9-1/2p to 766p.
Dealers and analysts said it was the timing of the announcement that unsettled the market rather than Thomas' appointment, who will take over from Peter Jarvis next summer.
"The announcement came a little early. It's just angst over that," said one market maker.
An analyst added, "I wouldn't read much into the (stock) decline. There was an element of surprise and that's it. It's not a reflection on Mr. Thomas."
He noted that volume was light, with fewer than 916,000 shares changing hands, and the shares were only 18p off the peak set on December 12.
